#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int total, limit;
    cin >> total >> limit;
    vector<int> data(total);
    for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) {
        cin >> data[i];
    }

    if (total % 2 == 1) {
        cout << 0;
        return 0;
    }

    unordered_map<int, int> diffMap;
    int evenCount = 0, oddCount = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) {
        if (data[i] % 2 == 0) evenCount++;
        else oddCount++;
        if (evenCount > 0 && oddCount > 0 && evenCount == oddCount && i + 1 < total) {
            diffMap[i] = abs(data[i] - data[i + 1]);
        }
    }

    if (diffMap.empty()) {
        cout << 0;
    } else if (diffMap.size() == 1) {
        int val = diffMap.begin()->second;
        cout << (val <= limit ? 1 : 0);
    } else {
        std::vector<int> vals;
        for (auto &kv : diffMap) {
            vals.push_back(kv.second);
        }
        std::sort(vals.begin(), vals.end());
        int count = 0;
        for (int v : vals) {
            if (v <= limit) {
                limit -= v;
                count++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        cout << count;
    }
    return 0;
}
